message.content: {"1833_8353802117877": {"answer": "C", "reason": "The CT images (Figures 4a, 4b) clearly show hyperdense material within the pulmonary arteries, which is characteristic of cement embolism following vertebroplasty."}, "1833_8353802248286": {"answer": "C", "reason": "The sudden drop in end-tidal CO2 combined with radiographic evidence of hyperdense intravascular material confirms a diagnosis of lung embolism by foreign body (cement)."}, "1833_8353802257454": {"answer": "C", "reason": "The imaging demonstrates pronounced vessels and hyperdense material in the pulmonary arteries, consistent with cement embolism caused by the recent vertebroplasty procedure."}, "1833_8353802279141": {"answer": "C", "reason": "The prominent vascular markings and hyperdense opacities in the pulmonary vasculature are indicative of pulmonary embolism by acrylic cement rather than fluid overload or infection."}}
